title: Map labelling #1
topic: holiday village · wildlife park · botanical garden · sports centre
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The holiday village.
Guide: Welcome to the holiday village. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the laundry. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the spa is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the bike hire. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: The boat house is directly behind the bike hire, at the back of the site.
Guide: The nature trail office is directly behind the laundry, at the back of the site.
Guide: The tennis courts is right next to the nature trail office, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The wildlife park.
Guide: Welcome to the wildlife park. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the picnic area. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the petting farm. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the ticket office is the first building on your left.
Guide: The bird aviary is directly behind the picnic area, at the back of the site.
Guide: The café is directly behind the petting farm, at the back of the site.
Guide: The first-aid post is directly behind the ticket office, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The botanical garden.
Guide: Welcome to the botanical garden. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the visitor centre. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the cactus house is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the glasshouse is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: The rose garden is directly behind the glasshouse, at the back of the site.
Guide: The play area is right next to the rose garden, on its right side.
Guide: The souvenir stall is right next to the rose garden, on its left side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The sports centre.
Guide: Welcome to the sports centre. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the changing rooms is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the dance studio. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the physio room. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: The climbing wall is directly behind the dance studio, at the back of the site.
Guide: The creche is directly behind the physio room, at the back of the site.
Guide: The reception is directly behind the changing rooms, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
